<function name="GetLastPosition" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the last registered or memorized position of the NPC. When using scheduling, the NPC will focus on navigating to the last position via nodes.

See <page>NPC:SetLastPosition</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2024.12.11</added>
	<rets>
		<ret name="position" type="Vector">Where the NPC's last position was set to.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
